name: Incline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on an incline bench set to 30 degrees holding dumbbells over your upper chest, palms facing in, slight bend in the elbows.
Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch.
Keep your elbows slightly bent throughout.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together.
Keep your shoulder blades pinned back.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A dumbbell fly on an incline bench that stretches the upper chest.
